about_desc: Watch Twitch VODs and live streams without a subscription, at full quality. Nothing to set up.
account_web_sub: Channel points, drops, and ad-free viewing on channels you're subbed to
ad_break_login_hint: Subscribed to this channel? Connect the web session (Settings → Twitch Account) to watch ad-free.
ad_break_sub: Twitch shows this screen instead of the stream during the break. Back in {n}s.
adm_delete_confirm: Delete this report and its photos?
adm_feedback_sub: Reply, change the status, delete — only visible to your account
adm_hook_missing: Discord: the FEEDBACK_WEBHOOK secret is missing from the Worker
adm_hook_never: Discord: nothing sent since the update
adm_seen_needs_update: “Seen” comes with the next site release: the server doesn't know it yet.
ap_account_expired: Twitch no longer accepts @{u}'s session: sign in again with this account.
ap_account_forget_q: Remove @{u} from this device? Using it again will require signing in.
ap_following_empty_local: Follow channels from their page (♡) to find them here.
ap_icon_failed: Android refused to change the icon: {e}
ap_icon_sub: Your launcher may take a few seconds to show the new icon. If the app disappears from your home screen, add it back from the app list.
ap_switch_account_sub: This account stays until the other one is connected: on twitch.tv/activate, sign in with the other account (in a private tab if your browser is already signed in). This one is kept below so you can switch back.
ap_sync_settings_sub: Chat, top streams language, hidden channels and categories, and the live events settings: the same on the website, the iPhone app and your devices signed in to this account. Language, quality, notifications and appearance stay specific to each device.
app_icon_blocked: The tool that installed the app (LiveContainer, GBox…) doesn't allow changing its icon.
app_icon_failed: iOS refused to change the icon: {e}
app_icon_sub: “Contrast” stays the sharpest with iOS 26's clear or tinted icons.
app_icon_unsupported: This install can't change its icon: the tool that installed the app may have removed the alternate icons.
app_icon_wildcard: The app was signed with your certificate's generic identifier (“{id}”): that's most likely why iOS refuses to change its icon (error -54). Feather 2.9 can't fix that yet; its next version adds a “Merge Entitlements” option: turn it on then, and sign and install the app again.
auto_claim_sub: Collects point chests as soon as they appear.
auto_pip_sub: When you leave the app during playback, the video keeps going in a small window.
background_play_sub: Sound keeps playing when you leave the app or turn the screen off, with controls in the notification.
backup_sub: Export your channels (followed, pinned, hidden), settings, customization and Continue watching to a file, to bring them elsewhere: the TU Test app, a reinstall, the website. Your Twitch sign-ins are never in it.
bg_playback_sub: Screen locked or another app, without PiP: playback continues, switches to audio only (less data) or pauses.
bot_commands_none_msg: This channel doesn’t use Nightbot, StreamElements, Fossabot or Moobot, or has no public commands there.
bot_commands_sub: Nightbot, StreamElements, Fossabot, Moobot: without typing in chat
br_cat_twitch: Followed on your Twitch account: unfollow it on Twitch.
br_cust_sub: Show, hide and reorder the tabs, and choose what Home shows.
br_followed_cats_foot: The row on Home. Follow a category with ♡ on its page; those followed on your Twitch account (web session) are added.
br_home_list_sub: Live streams in a list like on Twitch (thumbnail on the left) instead of the grid: Home and categories.
br_reset_confirm: Tabs and Home go back to how they were at first launch.
br_tabs_foot: Use the arrows to change the order. At least one tab always stays.
br_widget_empty: None of your followed channels is live.
br_widget_setup: Sign in with Twitch or follow channels in TwitchUnblock to see them here.
cache_auto_sub: Purge the cache when leaving the stream or the app
cat_followed_empty_msg: Follow categories on Twitch, or open a category and tap “Follow”.
cat_followed_empty_msg_local: Open a category and tap “Follow”: it will show up here.
cellular_quality_sub: On mobile data, lives and VODs start in this quality. “Auto” follows your connection speed, so the picture no longer freezes when the network weakens.
cfg_autocomplete_sub: Suggests emotes and names while typing.
cfg_chat_input_sub: Text field, emotes and Send button under the chat. Hidden, for those who only read: the room goes to the messages, live and in landscape; points and the ⋯ menu stay at the bottom right of the chat.
cfg_chat_overlay_pos_sub: In landscape, when the chat sits on the video: left or right, full height or in a corner.
cfg_chat_sync_sub: Live messages wait for the video to catch up: the delay follows the player (stalls, back to live). Yours show right away. The ⏱ badge above the chat turns sync off or on.
cfg_chat_width_sub: Landscape only, whether the chat is a column or sits on the video.
cfg_deleted_sub: Keeps moderated messages struck through instead of removing them.
cfg_drops_notice_sub: A card at the top of the chat when the channel has drops (dismissable)
cfg_edge_swipe: Swipe from the edge to close
cfg_edge_swipe_sub: Swipe in from the left edge of the screen to close the player, like ✕.
cfg_events_sub: Show polls, predictions and hype train
cfg_follow_sub: In the player, above the messages. The channel page keeps its own.
cfg_kbd_suggest_sub: Predicted words above the keyboard and iOS autocorrect. Turn them off if iOS keeps correcting your emotes.
cfg_land_notices_sub: Pinned message, drops, polls, predictions and raids on a single line above the chat; tap it to expand them
cfg_recent_sub: Twitch sends nothing from before you join. Recent lines are fetched from recent-messages.robotty.de, a third-party service.
cfg_return_sends_sub: Otherwise the Return key hides the keyboard and the ➤ button sends.
cfg_sync_settings_sub: Chat, top streams language, VOD speed, customization, pinned and hidden channels: the same on the website and on your devices signed in to this account. Language, quality, notifications and appearance stay specific to each device.
cfg_time_format_sub: Time of chat messages and of the log. Auto follows your device’s setting.
cfg_timestamps_sub: Shows the time in front of each message.
cfg_title_sub: Show the title above the chat
chat_auth_failed: Twitch refused your account in the chat: read-only. Sign in to Twitch again in Settings.
chat_ban_banner: Banned from this chat: read-only, without your account
chat_ban_switched: Twitch won't let your account into this chat (banned): it keeps going read-only, without your account.
chat_cleared: The chat was cleared by a moderator.
chat_gif_source: GIPHY GIF, sent with Twitch's GIF keyboard
chat_rej_automod: Message held by the channel's automatic moderation.
chat_rej_banned: Message not sent: you're banned from this chat.
chat_rej_duplicate: Message not sent: identical to your previous one.
chat_rej_emotes: Message not sent: only emotes are allowed.
chat_rej_followers: Message not sent: only the channel's followers can chat. Follow it to join in.
chat_rej_followers_time: Message not sent: you need to have followed the channel for {d} to chat.
chat_rej_ratelimit: Message not sent: too many messages at once, wait a bit.
chat_rej_slow: Message not sent: slow mode, wait a bit between messages.
chat_rej_subs: Message not sent: the chat is for subscribers only.
chat_rej_suspended: Message not sent: this chat isn't available.
chat_rej_timeout: Message not sent: you're timed out in this chat.
chat_rej_unique: Message not sent: unique-messages mode, this one was already posted.
chat_rej_verified: Message not sent: this channel requires a verified account (email or phone).
chat_sync_adjust_sub: Chat still ahead of the video? Add a few seconds. Behind? Take some off. Also by long-pressing the ⏱ badge above the chat.
chat_sync_hint: Chat ahead of or behind the video?
chat_sync_off: Real-time chat, {s} s ahead of the video. Tap to sync it.
chat_sync_on: Chat delayed by {s} s to match the video. Tap for real-time chat.
chat_timed_out: You've been timed out in this chat for {d}.
chat_unreachable: The chat isn't responding. Check your connection (VPN, filtered network) or tap “Reconnect chat” in the chat menu.
clip_done_sub: Twitch still needs a few seconds to process it before it shows.
clip_err_disabled: This channel doesn’t allow clips, or keeps them for some viewers (subscribers, followers).
clip_err_network: Twitch didn’t answer. Check your connection and try again.
clip_err_offline: The channel is no longer live.
clip_err_rate: Too many clips in a row: try again in a moment.
clip_needs_web: Clips are made with your Twitch account: connect the web session (as for channel points), and the clip is made at the same moment.
cloud_sync_sub: Recent channels and VODs, and where you stopped in VODs, shared with the iPhone app and the website (with your Twitch account).
color_needs_relogin: Log out and back in: the “change colour” permission was added after you signed in.
confirm_logout: Are you sure you want to log out?
credits_contrib_swipe: More responsive swipe-down on the player
credits_thanks: Thanks to BetterTTV, FrankerFaceZ, 7TV, recent-messages and Luminous.
cust_channel_tabs_foot: The page opens on the first tab shown. Schedule only appears when the channel has one.
cust_chat_buttons_foot: If you hide them here, the bell stays on the channel page and the points in the chat’s ⋯ menu; a refused message still says why.
cust_followed_cats_foot: Home → Categories → Followed. Compact: 3 covers per row on iPhone, more on a wider screen.
cust_home_foot: Each card only shows when relevant: an announcement or poll running, no account, no web session, a VOD you started.
cust_no_account_foot: Hides everything that needs an account or asks you to log in: the Twitch Account, Drops and Channel points pages of Settings, Home's sign-in cards, log-in reminders in the player, chat and predictions, and clip creation. Followed channels stay on this device.
cust_no_account_signed_in: You're logged in (app account or web session): nothing would be hidden. Log out first in Settings → Twitch Account.
cust_pinned_viewers_foot: Pinned channels' streams stay at the top of Following, most watched first. Off: in the order you pinned them.
cust_player_foot: Immersive player, left to right. PiP, chat, multi-live and rewind only show when they apply; sleep timer, multi-live and rewind also stay in the ⋯ menu.
cust_reset_confirm: Tabs, home, player buttons and chat banners go back to how they were at first launch.
cust_special_events_foot: Special Events: Twitch’s own reward campaigns (“1 Month of Apple TV”…), shown as a card like drops on many channels. Hide them and the channel’s drops still show.
cust_sub: Show, hide and reorder what you want: tabs, home, player buttons and chat banners.
cust_tabs_foot: Drag ≡ to reorder. At least one tab always stays.
dbg_latency_sub: Player badge: how far behind live, in seconds
debug_note: New features still being polished: they may change or misbehave. Feedback is welcome on Discord.
discord_msg: News, bugs, ideas: the TwitchUnblock community is on Discord. You can also find it later in Settings → About.
dl_chapters_sub: Tap a chapter to keep just that part, then others to extend it.
dl_chat_sub: Replayed offline with the video, emotes included.
dl_empty: No downloaded VODs. In a VOD's player, ⋮ → Download, to watch it offline with its chat.
dl_error: Couldn't read this quality: try another one.
dl_failed_refused: Twitch refuses some segments ({c}), retry later
dl_failed_space: not enough storage on the device
dl_no_space: Not enough space: this part takes about {s} and only {f} is left. Free up some space, or pick a shorter part or a lower quality.
dl_no_space_vod: Not enough space: this VOD takes about {s} and only {f} is left. Free up some space, or pick a lower quality.
dl_note: Downloading is fastest with the app open. If you leave it or lock your iPhone, iOS keeps going on its own, sometimes more slowly; if you swipe the app away, it resumes when you open it again. Your downloads are in the {tab} tab, and can be exported as a single file (Files, AirDrop, VLC).
dl_restore: Keep the sound of muted parts
dl_restore_sub: For copyrighted music, Twitch keeps the original sound for a day or two after the stream: while it still exists, it's downloaded instead of the muted part.
dl_wifi_needed: “Wi-Fi only” is on and you're on cellular data: connect to Wi-Fi to download.
dl_wifi_only_sub: Nothing downloads over cellular data: a download waits for Wi-Fi, then resumes on its own.
drops_autoclaim_sub: As soon as a drop is complete, the app claims it for you (checked every 5 min during a live, and when you open this page).
drops_available_empty: No other open campaign right now.
drops_available_sub: Every campaign running right now: watch a live of the game (“DropsEnabled” tag) to move it to “Campaigns in progress”.
drops_claim_fail: Couldn't claim this drop right now. Try again in a moment.
drops_empty: No drops in progress. Watch a live with drops (“DropsEnabled” tag) to earn some.
drops_error: Couldn't load drops. Try again in a moment.
drops_help_1: Connect your Twitch web session here, with the same account as the app.
drops_help_2: If the campaign asks for it, link your game account (“Link” button): without it, Twitch gives nothing. Twitch badges and emotes don't need it.
drops_help_3: In the app, watch a live of the campaign's game on a channel with drops enabled (“DropsEnabled” tag). VODs, reruns and rewinding don't count.
drops_help_4: Keep the live playing with “Earn drops while watching” on; lock screen and Picture in Picture count too. One channel at a time, and Twitch takes a few minutes to show the first minutes.
drops_help_5: When the bar is full, claim the reward, or let the app do it, before the campaign ends.
drops_link: Game account not linked: without it, Twitch doesn't grant the reward.
drops_login: Drops go through your Twitch session, like channel points: connect it once.
drops_notify_sub: A notification when a drop is ready to claim, or when the app has claimed it for you.
drops_progress_sub: Twitch only counts drops when your account loads the stream itself. During a live with drops, the app does it quietly: small requests, without downloading the video twice.
drops_status_active: @{c}: your drops progress while you watch.
drops_status_failing: @{c}: progress blocked, Twitch refuses the web session. Reconnect it.
drops_status_idle: No live playing in the app: start a live of a campaign to make your drops progress.
drops_status_none: @{c} has no drops right now: watch a live of a campaign's game.
drops_status_off: “Earn drops while watching” is off: nothing progresses during lives.
emote_hidden_note: Hidden: the chat shows it as the typed word.
emote_modifier: Modifier: changes how another emote looks
emotes_open_live: Open a stream to load the channel's emotes
err_clip: This clip could not be found
err_geo_blocked: This live stream isn't available in your region: Twitch limits it to certain countries (broadcast rights), and none of our sources can reach it.
err_no_source: No source answered for this live stream.
err_playback: Playback failed. Try again, or pick another quality.
err_vod_unavailable: VOD not found or for subscribers only.
expert_all_no_db: This Worker has no D1 database: backups, feedback and notifications wouldn't work on it. The option stays off.
expert_all_sub: Also history backups, feedback, announcements and the usage count. Your Twitch token is then sent to it (backups): only turn this on for a Worker you host yourself.
expert_bad: This address doesn't answer like a TwitchUnblock Worker.
expert_http: iOS refuses http:// addresses outside your local network: it needs HTTPS (Caddy, Cloudflare Tunnel…).
expert_http_android: Android refuses http:// addresses: it needs HTTPS (Caddy, Cloudflare Tunnel…).
expert_ok: Worker checked: it's now tried first.
expert_quota: This Worker has reached its quota (Cloudflare): try again later (the daily quota resets at midnight UTC).
expert_unreachable: This Worker doesn't answer (address, network or certificate).
expert_worker_sub: If TwitchUnblock's Worker goes down or disappears, the app can use yours instead (deployed from the site's repository, on Cloudflare or with Docker). It's tried first for lives, VODs and playlists; the official Workers stay as a fallback.
fb_closed_note: The developer closed this conversation: you can no longer reply. For anything else, send a new report.
fb_failed: Could not send, try again later.
fb_full_note: This conversation has reached 100 messages: send a new report to continue.
fb_gone: This report is no longer available.
fb_info_android: Attached automatically: app version, device model, Android version, and the latest errors from the log.
fb_mine_empty: Reports sent from the app will show up here, with the replies.
fb_name_ph: Your nickname (optional, so we recognize you)
fb_ph_bug: What happened? What did you expect? On which channel or VOD?
fb_ph_idea: Your idea, and what it would be useful for.
fb_sign_sub: {login}: the developer will know it’s you
fb_thanks_follow: Thanks! Follow the reply in “My reports”.
fb_too_many: Too many messages at once: try again in an hour.
feedback: Report a bug or suggest an idea
feedback_sub: A problem or an idea: your message goes straight to the developer.
fill_screen_sub: Zooms the picture to the edges in landscape, at the cost of the top and bottom. Left off, the whole picture shows with even bars on the sides. No effect in portrait.
fl_cast_live_only: Chromecast only plays live streams: casting stopped
fl_dl_after_live: Download: available once the stream ends
fn_notif_blocked: Android is blocking the app's notifications: allow them in its settings to get live alerts.
fn_ntfy_failed: Couldn't reach the server right now: try again later.
fn_ntfy_limited: ntfy.sh isn't accepting messages right now (sending limit reached): try again later.
fn_ntfy_status: {n} followed channels taken into account (Twitch account and this device).
fn_ntfy_status_one: {n} followed channel taken into account (Twitch account and this device).
fn_ntfy_test_sent: Sent: it shows up in ntfy within a few seconds.
follow_failed: Twitch didn't apply this follow change.
follow_hide_button: Hide this button in the player
follow_hide_hint: You can bring it back in Settings → Chat → Customization.
following_empty: Sign in with Twitch, or follow channels from their page (♡), to find them here.
following_none: You don't follow any channel yet.
hidden_emotes_empty: None. Long-press an emote in the chat, or open its card → “Hide this emote”: it will show as the typed word.
hidden_emotes_sub: In the chat (live, VODs, multi-live), they show as the typed word. They follow your account, website included.
hidden_empty: Nothing hidden. Long-press a stream or a category, then “Hide”.
hidden_sub: They no longer show up in Top or in categories. Search still finds them, and what you follow is never hidden.
higher_qualities: Higher qualities (if the channel offers them)
higher_qualities_sub: 1440p and above, sometimes in HEVC or AV1, on channels using Enhanced Broadcasting. Twitch only serves them to a signed-in account: 1440p goes through your account (web session, setting above). Without a sub or Turbo, during Twitch ad breaks, playback switches to 1080p without ads, then comes back. Decoded by this device: {c}. Applies to the next stream you open.
highlight_words_sub: Comma-separated. Messages containing them (or mentioning you) stand out.
hint_is_search: Will search channels, categories, live streams and VODs
history_vods_empty: No VOD in your history yet.
history_vods_empty_msg: VODs you play show up here, with resume playback.
home_list_sub: Live streams in a list like on Twitch (thumbnail on the left) instead of a grid: Home, categories and search
hype_departed: The Hype Train has left the station!
hype_departed_sub: Limited time to earn exclusive emotes
immersive_player_sub: Controls and info over the picture, fading out on their own. Off: Apple's player with its own controls, PiP and system full screen.
import_bad: This file is not a TwitchUnblock backup
import_capped: — %d left out: at most 300 followed channels on this device
import_choice_msg: Everything: channels, settings (language, qualities, chat, player, appearance, notifications, downloads, customization) and Continue watching. Channels only: followed, pinned and hidden channels, and followed categories. Nothing is removed.
import_sum_channels_only: Settings left as they were (channels only).
import_sum_ignored: Settings skipped (unknown to this version or invalid): {n}
lang_ai_note: Translated with AI, not yet reviewed: if something sounds off, let us know.
liquid_glass_sub: Floating tab bar and glass buttons, iOS 26 style.
live_activity_sub: What's playing on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island (channel, title, playback). Turned off, it goes away right away.
live_source_order_sub: Tried in this order: if a source doesn't answer, the next one takes over. None of them blocks the channel's ad breaks; if you're subscribed, turn on “Watch ad-free with my sub”. Picking a source from the player menu moves it to the top.
live_source_sub: Luminous and the Albanian proxy avoid most ads, but Twitch can still show “Commercial break in progress” during the channel's ad breaks. The chosen source is tried first; if it doesn't answer, the others take over.
local_follow_empty_msg: Open a channel page and tap “Follow”: it will show up here as soon as it goes live.
login_intro: Optional: for your Twitch follows and to chat. Everything else works without an account.
login_optional_msg: Optional: for your Twitch follows, chat and channel points. Everything else works without an account.
login_points_hint: For channel points, also connect the "Web session" from Settings ⚙️
login_prompt: Log in to find your favorite channels.
login_required: Please log in to view live streams.
logout_web_too: The web session (points, drops, predictions) stays connected. Remove it too?
logs_empty_hint: Start a VOD or a stream to see the logs
logs_hint: Launch a VOD or stream to see logs
low_latency_sub: Stays as close to live as possible (like on Twitch). May buffer a bit more on a slow connection. Applies to the next stream you open.
menu_chat_only_sub: Hides the video and gives the chat the whole screen.
menu_chatters_note: Twitch shut down its presence API: only IRC still announces people joining, and only on modestly sized channels. The list can therefore stay empty on big streams.
menu_chatters_sub: Who is in the chat right now.
menu_points_sub: The channel’s balance, rewards and bonus chests.
menu_reconnect_sub: Restarts the connection without leaving the stream.
menu_reload_emotes_sub: Clears the cache and fetches everything anew.
more_needs_login: Twitch won't load more without an account right now. Log in with Twitch to see more.
more_unavailable: Twitch isn't giving the rest right now.
multi_add_channel: Add a channel or a VOD
multi_add_ph: Channel, or VOD link or ID
multi_add_sub: up to 4 streams or VODs side by side
multi_chat_sub: The chat of the video you hear (replayed for a VOD), next to the mosaic (iPad, or a large iPhone in landscape).
multi_hint: Tap a video to hear it
muted_words_sub: Comma-separated: messages containing them are not shown.
n6_home_order_foot: The arrows change the order of Home's sections; the switch hides them.
native_tabs_sub: iOS 26's own tab bar instead of the app's: it shrinks while you scroll and the system places it for the screen (iPad, iPhone Duo). In testing: report what's off.
no_followed_live: None of your channels are live
no_followed_live_msg: Have a look at the Top or the categories meanwhile.
no_live: No live channels at the moment.
not_affiliated: Independent project, not affiliated with Twitch.
notif_bell_off: Live notifications for this channel: off
notif_bell_on: Live notifications for this channel: on
notif_bg_off: “Background App Refresh” is off (or Low Power Mode is on): iOS won’t wake the app. iOS Settings → General → Background App Refresh.
notif_bg_refused: iOS refused to schedule the check
notif_channels_error: Couldn't load the channels you follow. Try again in a moment.
notif_channels_none: You don't follow any channel yet.
notif_channels_sub: Live notifications (app wake-ups) only cover the channels switched on here. A channel you follow later is on by default.
notif_channels_sub_android: Live notifications (checks every 15 minutes and ntfy) only cover the channels switched on here. A channel you follow later is on by default.
notif_last_never: No background check yet. iOS picks the moment: leave the app in the background (without closing it) for a few hours.
notif_live_sub: Get notified when a followed channel goes live (checked in the background when iOS allows it; Twitch follows and follows on this device).
notif_live_sub_android: Lets you know when a followed channel goes live: checked every 15 minutes, even with the app closed.
notif_pwa_sub: Even with the app closed, within a minute: add the website to your Home Screen (in Safari: Share → Add to Home Screen, iOS 16.4 or later), open it from its icon, then Settings → Notifications → “Followed channels going live”. Log in with your Twitch account to get your channels.
notif_pwa_title: Instant notifications: the website as a web app
notif_test_denied: Notifications denied: allow them in iOS Settings → TwitchUnblock.
notif_test_sent: Sent: it arrives in 3 s (leave the app to see it like a real one).
ntfy_pending: On, but the server didn't answer: the app retries by itself every time you come back to it.
ntfy_retired_body: The app no longer goes through ntfy: you can uninstall it. To know when a channel goes live, install the website as a web app: it sends the notifications itself, with no third-party app.
ntfy_status: {n} followed channels taken into account (Twitch account and this device).
ntfy_sub_android: Within a minute, through the free ntfy app: turn on, then “Subscribe in ntfy”. Replaces the app's own notifications while it works.
ob_home_text: Your followed channels that are live, the top streams, and your offline channels in their own tab. No account? Tap “Follow” on a channel page and it shows up here.
ob_library_text: Your VODs resume where you left off.
ob_search_text: Type a name for their lives, VODs, highlights, playlists and clips — recently deleted or hidden VODs show up too, marked “Unlisted VOD”. Or paste a VOD link to open it right away.
ob_searchtab_text: To find a channel or open a VOD.
ob_settings_text: Your avatar opens the settings: Twitch account (optional) and web session for channel points, player, chat, backup… and the changelog.
ob_tip_lock: Lock screen and Dynamic Island: the live or VOD you’re watching, with its controls.
ob_tip_more: Picture in picture, sleep timer, and the chat with channel points.
ob_tip_seek: Drag a VOD’s seek bar: the time you’re seeking to shows up.
ob_tip_zoom: Spread two fingers on the video to zoom in.
ob_welcome_text: Twitch lives and VODs at full quality, with no subscription, and the real chat. Pick your language, then take a one-minute tour of the app.
offline_all_live: All your followed channels are live!
offline_play_failed_msg: The app's local server didn't start. Try again in a moment; if it keeps happening, restart the app.
pin_streamer: Pin to the top of Following
pip_on_leave_sub: Minimizing a live stream or VOD (swipe down, back arrow) opens it in Picture in Picture instead of the mini player, while the video is playing. Immersive player only.
pl_audio_comp_sub: Evens out loud peaks and brings up quiet parts, like FrankerFaceZ’s. Lives, VODs and multi-live.
points_connect_desc: Required to show your balance and claim chests.
points_tracker_empty: Nothing yet: watch a stream with your web session connected to earn points.
pred_need_login: To predict, connect your Twitch session with the channel points button
pref_quality_sub: Used when a stream or VOD starts. If it isn't available, the closest one below is used. Picking a quality in the player replaces it.
proxy_sub: Disable to save server resources (useful for VLC)
pt_empty: Nothing counted yet: watch a live stream with your web session connected.
pt_login: Points are earned and counted with your web session connected (like drops).
pt_note: Counted on this device while your web session is connected: the minutes Twitch counts for points, and the points earned by watching (passive, streaks, chests), not prediction winnings.
pt_reset_confirm: Clear the counted time and points?
recover_empty: No past broadcast found for this channel.
recover_sub: Past broadcasts, even removed from Twitch, found while they're still on its servers.
recover_unavailable: The removed-VOD source isn't responding. Try again later.
reply_not_connected: Reply not sent: the chat isn’t connected with your account.
reply_too_long: Reply not sent: 500 characters at most.
restore_muted_sub: Twitch mutes parts with copyrighted music. For a day or two after the stream the original is still available: the app puts it back when it can. No effect over AirPlay.
rewind_sub: Go back within the live stream
sched_local_hint: Days and times in your device's time zone.
search_empty_msg: Type a streamer name, a game or words from a stream title: results come in tabs (channels, categories, live streams, VODs). A VOD link or ID opens directly.
search_empty_title: Search a channel, game or stream, or paste a link
sec_general_sub: Language, chests, sleep timer, history, cache
session_expired: Session expired. Please log in again.
share_usage_sub: At most one signal an hour for the public statistics (/stats): language, device type, live sources. Never the channels you watch.
show_recent_sub: Shortcuts to the channels you opened last, in Search. Off, opened channels are no longer remembered.
sleep_timer_sub: Stops playback once the delay is over.
spatial_audio_sub: “Off” turns spatial audio, and so head tracking, off in the app. iOS doesn't let an app pick “Fixed”: Control Center → touch and hold the volume → Spatial Audio, or, for every app, turn off “Follow iPhone” in the AirPods Accessibility settings.
speed_caught_up: Caught up with the live: normal speed
speed_live_note: During a live: used to catch up after going back; back to 1× at the live edge.
src_custom_bad: Address refused: https://, a domain name, no port or parameters.
src_custom_sub: Address of your own luminous-ttv server (https://…): it goes to the top of the order above. Empty: no custom source.
st_cast_failed: The device couldn't play this stream. Try another quality.
st_cast_searching: Looking for devices on this Wi-Fi network…
st_cast_unavailable: Casting unavailable: this phone needs Google Play services.
st_custom_sub: Address of your own luminous-ttv server (https://…): it's tried before every other source. Empty: no custom source.
st_hq_sub: 1440p and above, sometimes in HEVC or AV1, on channels using Enhanced Broadcasting. Twitch only serves them to a signed-in account: on Android, only when your account watches the channel ad-free (sub or Turbo, with the web session and “Watch ad-free with my sub”). Decoded by this device: {c}. Applies to the next stream you open.
sub_adfree_sub: If you're subscribed to the channel (or have Turbo), the stream goes through your Twitch account: no ad breaks, just like on Twitch. Twitch then sees your account watching. Needs the web session.
switch_account_sub: Twitch will ask for your credentials: sign in with the other account.
title: Watch Twitch No Sub
top_lang_sub: Streamer language. Defaults to your device language ({l}).
tv_chat_layout_hint: Default settings. In the player, the Chat menu shows, hides or moves the chat for the channel you're watching, and the app remembers it for that channel.
tv_error: Couldn't load. Try again in a moment.
tv_hidden_hint: Press and hold the center button on a Top or category card, then “Hide”.
tv_login_expired: The code expired or sign-in failed. Try again.
tv_login_intro: Sign in with Twitch to see your followed channels. Everything else works without an account.
tv_login_steps: Scan the QR code with your phone, or go to
tv_need_login: Sign in from the Account tab to see your followed channels that are live.
tv_usage_sub: Logged out: a random install identifier and the app version. Logged in: your Twitch account, so you count once across the iPhone, the Apple TV and the website. Plus the language and the number of plays (live source, failures). At most once an hour, no channels watched, no IP address. Turning it off erases it all from the server.
unlisted_hint: Unlisted VODs (deleted or hidden) are rebuilt from an external source, as long as Twitch still serves their segments.
update_msg: Version {v} is out (you have {c}). Update it from Feather, SideStore or AltStore.
update_msg_short: A new version of TwitchUnblock is available. Install it from Feather, SideStore or AltStore.
update_none: The app is up to date
update_stale_msg: Your install tool put an old build ({b}) under the number {v}: you don't actually have {v}. Delete the app and reinstall it from GitHub. To keep your channels and settings, export a backup first (Settings → General → Backup).
update_whats_new: Here’s what’s new since your version:
usage_share_sub: Logged out: a random install identifier and the app version. Logged in: your Twitch account, so you count once across the app and the website. Plus the language, iPhone or iPad, the iOS version and the number of plays (live source, failures). At most once an hour, no channels watched, no IP address. Turning it off erases it all from the server.
usage_tap_refresh: Tap Refresh to read the counters.
usage_worker_missing: The server does not have the counting routes yet. See worker/README.md to deploy them.
vibecoded: Vibe-coded project: the app is written with AI coding assistants, then reviewed and tested by hand. Bugs can slip through, report them on Discord.
vlc_player_sub: Custom controls: double-tap ±10s, live rewind. (no PiP)
vod_chat_empty: No messages at this point of the VOD
vod_chat_err_file: This download's chat can't be read
vod_chat_err_twitch: Twitch didn't return the chat, retrying…
vod_goto_time: Go to a time of day
vod_goto_time_sub: Streamed from {a} to {b}. Pick the real time of a moment of the stream.
vod_unmuted: Original sound restored on muted parts
web_banner_msg: For channel points, auto-claimed chests and predictions: sign in once to twitch.tv inside the app.
web_expired_sub: Twitch rejected the web session. Channel points, polls and predictions stay unavailable until it is restored.
web_load_failed: Couldn't load the Twitch sign-in page. Check your internet connection.
web_login_sub: Points, predictions, polls, follows and drops
web_mismatch_sub: The web session belonged to @{w}, but the app uses @{a}: it was disconnected so the accounts don't get mixed up (points, drops, predictions). Connect it again with @{a}.
web_wrong_account: This account (@{w}) isn't the app's account (@{a}). Sign in with @{a}.
